_name: Long-Term BTC Cycle Strategy — Grid V2
_description: V2 of the macro cycle-aware allocation strategy. Same regime logic and top/bottom signals as V1 (Mayer Multiple 2.4 / 0.8, Pi Cycle Top, 200W SMA). More frequent execution: 4% rebound/drawback triggers (vs 5% in V1) and smaller 20% tranches (vs 25%), generating 211 trades vs 168. Backtested on 9yr BTCUSDT 1m 2017-2026: ×24.2 return (+34.7% vs buy-and-hold), CAGR 43.9%, MaxDD 81.4%, Calmar 0.54.

_backtest.aggregation: 1m → daily OHLCV (day high for top signals, day low for bottom signals)

_vs_V1: Identical top/bottom signals and regime logic. Only execution differs: rebound 4% vs 5%, drawback 4% vs 5%, tranche 20% vs 25%.

top_signals._comment: Any one fires after min_bull_days in BULL → switch to BEAR

bottom_signals._comment: Any one fires after min_bear_days in BEAR → switch to BULL

execution._comment: In BEAR: sell on rebounds. In BULL: buy on drawbacks. Smaller tranches and tighter triggers vs V1 for more frequent accumulation/distribution.
